ModuleMetaData.DescriptionHeadline: OGRE OpenGL ES 2 and 3 render system plugin, Wayland flavour
ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: The sources of OgreRenderSystem_GLES2 (the directory GLES2) linked with OgreGLSupport_Wayland, so that its render windows are made on a wl_surface of a Wayland window (externalWlDisplay, externalWlSurface). An application on Wayland lists this plugin instead of OgreRenderSystem_GLES2; the render system has the same name. The module lists the sources of the other directory in its ProjectGenInstructions.xml.
